name: Calingasta
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

blurb.text: A wine area in San Juan, with Barreal, Hilario, Sorocayense and Tamberías inside. Malbec dominates plantings at 64%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon (17%) and Syrah (3%).
